note: Quick-reference formulas and rules. Concise study companion; each group maps to topics covered by the app's lessons and exam sims.

entries.name: Future value (lump sum)
entries.formula: FV = PV × (1 + r)^n
entries.note: Compound growth of a single amount.

entries.name: Present value (lump sum)
entries.formula: PV = FV ÷ (1 + r)^n
entries.note: Discount a future amount to today.

entries.name: PV of an ordinary annuity
entries.note: Payments at period end.

entries.name: Bond price
entries.formula: Price = PV(coupons at market yield) + PV(face at market yield)
entries.note: Sells at a discount when the stated rate < market yield.

entries.name: Gordon growth (stock value)
entries.note: D1 = next dividend; requires r > g.

entries.name: CAPM (cost of equity)
entries.formula: re = rf + β × (rm − rf)
entries.note: Market risk premium = rm − rf.

entries.name: WACC
entries.formula: WACC = (E/V)·re + (D/V)·rd·(1 − Tc)
entries.note: Debt cost is after-tax.

entries.name: NPV
entries.formula: NPV = Σ CFt ÷ (1 + r)^t − initial outlay
entries.note: Accept if NPV > 0.

entries.name: Profitability index
entries.formula: PI = PV of inflows ÷ initial investment
entries.note: Accept if PI > 1 (consistent with NPV > 0).

entries.name: DM price variance
entries.formula: (actual price − standard price) × actual quantity
entries.note: Isolates purchasing.

entries.name: DM quantity variance
entries.formula: (actual qty − standard qty allowed) × standard price
entries.note: Standard qty is for ACTUAL output (flexible budget).

entries.name: Contribution margin
entries.formula: CM = price − variable cost per unit
entries.note: Fixed cost is irrelevant to a special order with idle capacity.

entries.name: Return on investment (ROI)
entries.formula: ROI = operating income ÷ invested capital
entries.note: Can cause underinvestment in projects below current ROI.

entries.name: Residual income (RI)
entries.formula: RI = operating income − (required rate × invested capital)
entries.note: Promotes goal congruence: accept any project above the capital charge.

entries.name: Opportunity cost (full capacity)
entries.formula: units displaced × lost contribution per unit
entries.note: Only relevant when there is no idle capacity.

entries.name: Finance lease (lessee)
entries.formula: Liability = PV of lease payments at the discount rate; ROU = liability + initial direct costs
entries.note: Finance lease if term ≥ major part (≈75%) of useful life, among other criteria.

entries.name: Bond effective interest
entries.formula: Interest expense = carrying value × market yield; amortization = interest − cash coupon
entries.note: Carrying value rises toward face on a discount bond.

entries.name: Goodwill (full-goodwill)
entries.formula: Goodwill = (consideration + NCI fair value) − FV of identifiable net assets
entries.note: NCI goodwill = NCI FV − NCI% × identifiable FV.

entries.name: Deferred tax
entries.formula: DTL/DTA = enacted rate × temporary difference
entries.note: Permanent differences (e.g., muni interest) never create deferred tax.

entries.name: Effective tax rate
entries.formula: total tax expense ÷ pretax book income
entries.note: = statutory rate on (book − permanent differences).

entries.name: QBI deduction
entries.formula: lesser of 20% × QBI, the wage/UBIA limit, or 20% of taxable income
entries.note: Wage limit = greater of 50% W-2 wages, or 25% W-2 + 2.5% UBIA.

entries.name: Net investment income tax
entries.formula: 3.8% × lesser of NII or (MAGI − threshold)
entries.note: Single threshold $200,000 on the 2026 baseline.

entries.name: §1031 recognized gain
entries.formula: lesser of realized gain or boot received
entries.note: 2026: like-kind applies to REAL property only.

entries.name: §1031 replacement basis
entries.formula: basis given up − boot received + gain recognized
entries.note: Preserves the deferred gain.

entries.name: S corp stock basis order (§1367)
entries.formula: +income → −distributions → −nondeductibles → −deduction/loss
entries.note: Losses beyond stock basis absorb debt basis, then suspend.

entries.name: Ratio-method projection
entries.formula: (sample misstatement ÷ sample book value) × population book value
entries.note: Use when misstatement scales with item size.

entries.name: Difference-method projection
entries.formula: (sample misstatement ÷ items sampled) × population items
entries.note: Use when misstatement is unrelated to item size.

entries.name: Performance materiality
entries.formula: a percentage (e.g., 75%) of overall materiality
entries.note: Set below overall to absorb undetected/uncorrected misstatement.

entries.name: DuPont (3-factor ROE)
entries.formula: ROE = net profit margin × asset turnover × equity multiplier
entries.note: ROA = margin × turnover; the multiplier is the leverage lift.
